post.title: Why is polling APIs for changes terrible for modern microservices? | Webhooks
post.subtitle:
Are your microservices wasting thousands of API calls every minute just asking 'Is there new data yet?' 🛠️

Learn how to master Stop Polling! Use Webhooks for Event-Driven Architecture in this quick breakdown.

📖 Read the full guide here:
https://www.abstractalgorithms.dev/

In this Short:
- Why is polling APIs for changes terrible for modern microservices?
- Polling wastes server bandwidth and introduces unnecessary latency.
- Webhooks push HTTP event payloads instantly when events trigger.
- Real-time event delivery with zero idle overhead and built-in retries.
- Full guide in description. Subscribe for more software engineering guides!
